description: Blueprint device budgets for quality presets and soft auto-downgrade. Presentation-only — never changes the 20 Hz sim.

android.label: Android mid-tier
android.resolutionNote: Native device resolution; Filament MSAA only on high

web.label: Web mid desktop @1080p
web.resolutionNote: Medium caps DPR ≤1.5 and draws at most 1080 CSS px tall; high ≤2× DPR

low.web: 1× DPR, no shadows, crowd≤3, fly≤4, burst≤2
low.android: no shadows, no MSAA, crowd≤3, fly≤4, burst≤2

medium.web: ≤1.5× DPR (≤1080 CSS tall), 1024 shadows, crowd≤5, fly≤8, burst≤4
medium.android: shadows on, no MSAA, crowd≤5, fly≤8, burst≤4

high.web: ≤2× DPR, 2048 soft shadows, crowd≤8, fly full pool, burst full pool
high.android: shadows + 4× MSAA, crowd≤8, fly full pool, burst full pool
